1.6.6-beta.3 (#3786)

* Fix syncManager test suite crashing on missing electron mock methods (#3761)

* Export/import Overlays #3762

* Trying to fix VideoToolbox ffmpeg issue

* Fix show metadata edits not bumping modified timestamp (#3767)

* Fixed RTMP test

* Trying to fix software encoding on some macOS devices

* Fixed file picker blocking main process on macOS #3770

* Choose any media input from Camera item #3760

* Updated QR Code id

* Drop media inputs directly on slides as items
- Added OMT & Blackmagic as supported media input slide backgrounds

* Change QR Code item colors

* Interactions Join slide uses QR Code item

* Tweak

* Drop audio files into effects directly

* Fixed playlist drop height

* Duplicated audio files in playlist works better

* Stop active playlist if playing audio not from playlist

* Fixed audio crossfade timing

* Fixed Smart translation name issue

* Tweaked playlist options

* Fixed an open dropdown causing menu to be stuck after unmount

* EQ Spectrum Analyzer

* Tweak

* Fix

* Generalized audio effect presets

* New RemoteShow Audio tab #3689

* Improved Audio Open in system #3774

* Project export includes show categories

* Item cutout only visible for text items

* Hide chosen system fonts

* Fixed local media dropped on slides added as embed instead of path

* Fixed NowPlaying updating if multiple are played at once
- Audio effects will not set NowPlaying

* Fix BMD frame timing issue

* PPT shapes update

* PPT import updates

* Smart generic multi-language dictionary system #3775

* Enhance merge logic for item-collections in sync process to handle conflicts based on whole file versioning (#3777)

* Stage font size fixes

* Fixed stage snapping

* Fix

* Chords should not overlap each other

* Fixed OSR using offscreen mode when it should not #3765

* Removed render groups because two NDI outputs with identical properties can hold different content
- When the user creates more outputs it's because it should hold different content, different outputs can have the same content, but should be different for the most part
- Also it would only work for NDI outputs, and generally people will only have max 1, so it's not worth it for all the clutter it makes

* Always use online provider item if no slides in local show

* Auto open timeline if closed

* Scenes (#3782)

* Tweak

* Locked overlays now remember the correct outputs

* Scenes quicksearch

* Fix

* Fixed Lines transition sometimes clipping #3783

* Updated scene preview & resolution

* Fixed item position value not relative when using a custom aspect ratio

* Fixed scene with custom aspect ratio

* Quick open scenes

* Fixed output items not properly updating when changing aspect ratio
- Fixed item position value not relative when using a custom aspect ratio

* Mute video audio if scene should not play video

* Fixed video audio playing in output with style background layer off

* Update video timing

* Fix

* Updates

* The same item on different slides remains fixed and does not fade between

* Output cropping sliders

* Missing output id match should fallback to any matching name for synced devices

* Fix

* Fixed output cropping alignment

* Fixed cropping not working well with custom aspect ratios

* Fixed output cropping issues

* Cropping should only affect output window

* Version update

---------

1.3.2-beta.1 (#1043)

* chore: non-conflicting dependency updates (#1016)

* use package-lock to ensure devs are using the same versions of dependencies

* update sqlite

* update genius-lyrics

* update @googleapis/drive

* add prettier in dev deps so the config is actually used

* update @rollup/plugin-commonjs

* update @rollup/plugin-typescript

* update rollup

* 📄 Reverted sqlite3 version

* 🎤 Fixed microphone input doubled
- Gain control integrated into volume fader
- Fixed auto size on Jesus red words
- Fixed scripture reference doubled in some cases

* ✨ Set tags for multiple shows at once
- Fixed translation issue
- Translation resets to default textbox on remove

* ✔ Fixed project folder right click add not working in empty area
- Fixed custom verse reference align style
- Fixed align style preview incorrect sometimes
- Added toggle variable action to list
- Fixed freeze when applying REST action to slide

* Update snapcraft.yaml (#1031)

* Update snapcraft.yaml

* More cleanup, switch to core24, enable wayland support

* ✨ Set variable value from action
- Optimized transition delay when set to none

* ✨ Overlay preview
- Overlays can be added to the project
- Project templates

* 📱 Remote Enhancements (#1042)

* 📱 Remote updates

* 🖼 Play media from remote
- Slide overlay in edit preview

* ✏ Edit text in remote
- Change show layout from the remote
- Remote clear layers
- Text edit style is preserved
- Text edit textbox number added as group

* ✨ Rearrange groups from remote
- Remote UI updates
- Remote loading
- Controller clear slide

* 📖 Play local scriptures from remote

* 📄 Updated version

* fix: search all lines for customType markers in scripture auto-sizing

The customTypeRatio calculation was only searching the first line (lines[0])
for verse numbers marked with customType: 'disableTemplate'. In templates
where verse numbers appear in other lines (e.g., line 1), this caused the
ratio to default to 1.0 instead of the correct value (e.g., 0.6 for 60px
verse numbers).

This resulted in inconsistent auto-sizing where some verses would be
calculated with extremely small font sizes because the algorithm treated
the verse number as if it should be the same size as the verse text.

Fixed by iterating through all lines to find customType markers in both:
- deriveCustomTypeRatio() function
- calculateAutosize() function

Now correctly calculates the verse number to text ratio regardless of
which line contains the verse numbers.

* Fixed formatting

Now intelligently matches verse text objects to {scripture_text} placeholder and verse numbers to {scripture_number} placeholder based on customType flag.
